messages:
claire: Quick RFC follow-up: propose a tiny discovery handshake so Private can be sidecarless by default. Minimal probe + per-tenant cache + legacy adapter fallback.

ben: Can we keep first-request latency under 10ms?

claire: Yes — block only on first contact per-tenant, warm connections should be <10ms. Cache TTL default 300s, runtimes may suggest cap_ttl_seconds (min 60, max 3600).

omar: Security: controlplane must never receive raw keys. Runtime returns attestation blob over mTLS; we validate signature and store only references.

claire: Fallback: if probe times out or missing, route to legacy adapter, mark tenant as "legacy_adapter" in cache, emit metric legacy_adapter_routes, show console warning.

ben: Add metrics and CB: discovery_latency_ms, discovery_error_pct, legacy_adapter_rate; if discovery_error_pct > 2% for 5m, auto-fail new tenants to legacy_adapter and page.

ops-bot: action: add feature-flag private_handshake_v2, metrics discovery_latency_ms and legacy_adapter_rate, alert on legacy_adapter_rate > 1% over 5m.

claire: I'll draft the follow-up RFC with state machine, probe schema (POST /_redwood/discover), cache policy, and rollout checklist. Who wants integration tests?

ben: I'll take integration tests. Omar will draft runtime README.

claire: Thanks — will post RFC later today. :rocket:
